scope: Sampled lift gate at recorded trace rate; original every-physics-step postlift hold and release outcomes remain preserved
downward_tolerance_interpretation: At most 2 mm total retreat from an already reached height during lift (default 2% of 100 mm command). This is an operational monotonicity tolerance, not a universal physical velocity limit.
dependency_limit: Fingerprint records dependencies at audit time. The evaluator cache itself does not hash referenced scene/mesh/hand files; it must be invalidated if these dependencies change. This fingerprint cannot retroactively prove an earlier unseen asset state.
